metadata.description: Primary-source lookup index for forecasting baselines, global/panel models, reconciliation, probabilistic evaluation and foundation models. Read the linked release docs or checkpoint cards before choosing APIs or quoting capabilities and benchmark ranks.
metadata.title: AI Ml Timeseries - Sources

foundations_and_benchmarks.name: Forecasting: Principles and Practice (3rd ed.)
foundations_and_benchmarks.relevance: Canonical reference for forecasting principles, baselines, and evaluation workflows.

foundations_and_benchmarks.name: M5 Forecasting Accuracy Competition
foundations_and_benchmarks.relevance: Benchmark reference for large-scale retail and feature-based forecasting workflows.

forecasting_frameworks.name: statsmodels Documentation
forecasting_frameworks.relevance: Local classical models and decomposition diagnostics.

forecasting_frameworks.name: LightGBM Documentation
forecasting_frameworks.relevance: Official tree-boosting reference used in feature-based forecasting stacks.

forecasting_frameworks.name: MLForecast Documentation
forecasting_frameworks.relevance: Official Nixtla docs for global feature-based forecasting with lags, date features, and static features.

forecasting_frameworks.name: HierarchicalForecast Documentation
forecasting_frameworks.relevance: Official reconciliation docs for coherent hierarchical and grouped forecasts.

forecasting_frameworks.name: skforecast Documentation
forecasting_frameworks.relevance: Official recursive and direct workflows around tabular regressors. Check the installed release against these docs before copying imports or backtesting signatures.

forecasting_frameworks.name: AutoGluon Time Series Documentation
forecasting_frameworks.relevance: Official AutoGluon docs for rapid time-series benchmarking, ensembling, and TSFM comparisons.

forecasting_frameworks.name: StatsForecast (Nixtla)
forecasting_frameworks.relevance: Statistical base forecasts; forecast(df=, h=, fitted=True) plus forecast_fitted_values() supply the in-sample values MinTrace needs.

forecasting_frameworks.name: NeuralForecast (Nixtla)
forecasting_frameworks.relevance: Deep forecasting baselines (NHITS, TFT, DeepAR and others); confirm the model list in the installed release.

probabilistic_and_calibration.name: MAPIE Documentation
probabilistic_and_calibration.relevance: Official conformal prediction reference, including current regression and time-series APIs.

foundation_models_and_governance.name: Chronos Forecasting Repository (includes Chronos-2 and Chronos-Bolt)
foundation_models_and_governance.relevance: Official Chronos family repository. Read the exact checkpoint card and inference docs for covariates, fine-tuning, licence, context and horizon support; benchmark speed and memory on the target hardware rather than transferring published ratios.

foundation_models_and_governance.name: Chronos-2: From Univariate to Universal Forecasting (paper)
foundation_models_and_governance.relevance: Primary evidence for the paper's benchmark results and covariate-informed experiments. Read the result table and comparator setup before quoting figures; a publication result is not a live leaderboard rank.

foundation_models_and_governance.name: TimesFM Repository
foundation_models_and_governance.relevance: Official TimesFM repository. Check the selected checkpoint's context, horizon, uncertainty head and fine-tuning instructions; use a dated benchmark snapshot when comparing its rank.

foundation_models_and_governance.name: Toto — Datadog Time-Series Foundation Model
foundation_models_and_governance.relevance: Official multivariate forecasting repository with an observability focus. Read the selected release's model card and feature notes before assuming fine-tuning or exogenous covariate support; compare general-domain fit on the local backtest.

foundation_models_and_governance.name: TiRex / TiRex-2 (NX-AI)
foundation_models_and_governance.relevance: Official TiRex repository, linking to the newer-generation repository. Follow the exact checkpoint's docs for covariates, multivariate support, fine-tuning and licence; do not transfer capabilities between generations.

foundation_models_and_governance.name: fev-bench: Realistic Forecasting Benchmark and Leaderboard
foundation_models_and_governance.relevance: Official forecasting benchmark and live leaderboard. Read the current task definitions, covariate availability and scoring setup before comparing models; record the snapshot date next to quoted rankings.

foundation_models_and_governance.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0
foundation_models_and_governance.relevance: Governance baseline for high-impact forecasting deployments and operational risk controls.

foundation_models_and_governance.name: Moirai / uni2ts (Salesforce)
foundation_models_and_governance.relevance: Moirai family repository; capabilities and licence differ per generation, so read the checkpoint card before shortlisting.

foundation_models_and_governance.name: GIFT-Eval leaderboard
foundation_models_and_governance.relevance: Live multi-task TSFM leaderboard; record the snapshot date next to any rank quoted.
